verdict.rationale: Noise suppression and audio filtering are a fair question for a voice AI agent platform, so the axis applies. But nothing in the evidence pack mentions noise suppression, background-noise filtering, or audio denoising settings. Provider choice (Deepgram, Azure) and speech-to-speech models are adjacent features, not the product's own documented noise-suppression capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls
